results.name: TT87 SHA-256 and canonical JSON match independent Node crypto, including Unicode and reordered object keys
TT87 checksum covers file bytes, path, MIME, tags, deletion, note fields, timestamp and bundle kind
TT87 refuses at least 15 malformed, unsafe, duplicate and unbounded shapes even when a checksum is recomputed
TT87 base64 size counts decoded bytes, not characters; UTF-8 uses bytes rather than UTF-16 units
TT87 legacy v1 requires a bijective manifest and explicitly warns of unprotected metadata, notes and settings
